Date of Birth: June 12, 1916
Place of Birth: Enfield, North Carolina

Date of Death: September 1, 1990

Mother’s Name: Pearl Clanton Francis
Father’s Name: James Henry Francis
Birth Order: Sixth child of fourteen children

ae

Rddie, better known as “Bud”, lived in the Enfield area all of his life. He
attended elementary school and joined the Daniel’s Chapel Baptist Church at a
young age where he was very active in church work and Sunday School. He

served as Sunday School superintendent for several years.

Ye

Bud was an agricultural farmer by profession. However, he was also an active
carpenter, trapper, hunter and fisherman. After he ceased farming, Bud

marketed vegetables and fruits.

SS N Bud had eleven children: Celestine, Shirley. Ellwood, Pearl, David, Rufus, ei
